remarks: Absolutely stunning! This beautifully renovated 10th-floor 1 bed/1 bath condo features an open layout with custom cabinetry, wood plank floors, and stainless steel appliances. Enjoy crown molding and breathtaking views from your home. Located just a 12-minute walk from the Stamford Train Station (Metro-North), "The Biltmore" offers a convenient shuttle service for easy commuting.  Located in the heart of downtown, this building grants you access to amazing amenities, including a 24-hour concierge, a fully renovated gym, a 4th-floor terrace, same-day dry cleaning, and on-site parking available through ProPark for just $115/month.  With a new hot water heater, HVAC system, and microwave (all updated in 2023/2024), this move-in ready condo is a fantastic rental opportunity: Don't miss out!
